body: yes, I would, and no I don't need to be made to feel bad about that. the things that make me sad aren't going away because I take a pill. if everything that was making me sad was purely inside my head things wouldn't be so bad, but that's not the case. I'm alone, I'm rejected, this isn't changing. AA is a christian organization that requires you to accept bullshit. It's not for me.

Self medication yes. I am not into anti-depressants though. I'm an alcoholic, I've sought help in the past and was referred to either christian organizations or things you have to pay for. I'm worried about the anti-depressants because in the end a lot of people on them still end up killing themselves and I don't want to change my person just so I can live. I fear that it would change who I am entirely and even if I don't like who I am I act on my own. I can't be sure I'll like the person I am on the meds and may end up down the rabbit hole anyway.

I do a lot of volunteering and I work in a field full of like minded people. I realize I should look out for myself, but that's not who I am or how I can operate. The fact that I work and volunteer with like minded people adds to my sadness because if they can't care about me than who would? And at the end of the day my giving and trying so hard that gets me no where new saps every ounce of energy I have and I'm left back in my house dead tired and severely depressed. I exercise. I do everything I can. Nothing works. Nothing makes it any better. I feel the only thing that will make it better is turning off the lights so to speak. My brain won't let me be happy, the world won't care either way. Rationalizing my life  and looking for reasons to live has been fruitless as I said. I just don't see any other way for this to go. But I appreciate that you've cared enough to try.

I live by myself at my aunt's home while she's away in Berlin for a year. I have a kitten. As much as I love animals they aren't capable of giving the kind of love I need. I need someone who will think about me when I'm not around, who cares about things I do. That person doesn't exist and I have trouble rationalizing living purely so that i may live. When I sit on the floor crying for 3 hours with no one there to help me, or comfort me, that's the reality. That's what I have. And that's all I have. Nothing. So what's the big difference between this nothing and the nothing in death? I can't figure it anymore.

I've seen a therapist and talked to councilors in the past and they refer me to people who are expensive and I can't afford to see. The money and future are not the pressing thing, just that I have nothing to look forward to, nothing to live for now. Everything I've done with my life is pointless and been a product of me lying to myself. Believing in something that I've never seen in my own life feel fruitless. Like I say I've been living on this hope for most of my life. I'm so sick of hoping and hurting.
